immutablePhase0PostRegionSnapshot.algorithm: sha256(filename + NUL + bytes + NUL, sorted by filename)

authorityBoundary.permittedInputs: coordinates, upstream geometry, D05 baseline/defaults/S01, D06 egress geometry, immutable copied region snapshot
excludedInputs: operations, manifests, preflight, live entities, execution, rollback, or post-state evidence
authorityBoundary.missingInputRule: Emit a dependency HOLD and null set hashes; never infer an empty accepted set, mountain, route, owner, interface, kernel, outlet, or construction cell.

coordinateRegistryZ09.relicRule: No-touch exhibit voids: preserve each generated structure in place, keep its exact blocks out of grading and shell ownership, and provide only separately approved observation access.

planningScope.interpretation: These bounds validate and limit future inputs. They own no block and cannot be filled to fabricate a mountain.

deterministicCompilerContract.coordinateOrder: numeric x, then y, then z
deterministicCompilerContract.canonicalBlockState: JSON object with Name first and Properties keys lexicographically sorted; complete properties required

orderedInputs: all twelve typed-family hashes in canonical order

compilationOrder: validate sources and immutable snapshot identity
validate proposed-state registry and total directly-modelled column functions
derive mutually exclusive direct state families
apply accepted finite influence kernels and directed drainage graph
apply relic support/access exclusions without promoting S01 candidates
validate one-owner assignments and exact directional interfaces
run no-unreviewed-overlap, component accounting, boundary receiver, and family completeness gates
emit hashes only when every required input and readiness check passes
overlapAndOwnershipRules: Direct material/change families are mutually exclusive per exact cell.
A derived diagnostic interaction family may reference a direct cell but never transfers its canonical physical owner.
Every physical direct or influence cell has exactly one owner; zero-owner and multi-owner cells fail.
Every accepted owner-to-owner adjacency or transition is matched one-to-one by an exact directional interface contract.
No wildcard, range-only seam, envelope ownership, last-writer-wins, or silent clipping is accepted.

rules: records are unique by coordinate and sorted x/y/z
every current state matches the immutable snapshot exactly
every changed record belongs to exactly one direct family
every directly modelled X/Z column has a deterministic future surface/solid function
unmodelled cells are unchanged, not implicitly air or fill
one canonical owner per physical direct or influence cell
coordination envelopes and diagnostic set membership never assign ownership
owner acceptance is external input; this compiler cannot self-accept
each observed cross-owner adjacency/transition matches exactly one contract
direction and receiver are mandatory for fluid, discharge, access, and sealed boundaries
wildcards, bounding-box-only approval, broad overlaps, and last-writer-wins are invalid
no inferred radius, wildcard, unbounded propagation, or boundary clipping
unknown influence is a HOLD and never an accepted empty set

influenceExpansionRules.rule: Direct cells come only from canonical before/future state differences and typed future-state records. Apply no radius, shell, or envelope expansion.
influenceExpansionRules.requiredInput: complete canonical proposed-state records for every direct cell

influenceExpansionRules.rule: Compile the explicit union of authored staging pads, access rasters, head/body clearance, temporary support, equipment sweep, and restoration cells; infer no corridor width.
influenceExpansionRules.requiredInput: exact per-package swept-volume records and one owner per cell

influenceExpansionRules.rule: Intersect the union of direct/staging cells with exact current water and lava cells, then include the full current six-connected component identity as diagnostic context without transferring ownership.
influenceExpansionRules.requiredInput: complete direct/staging union and bound D05 water/lava component manifests

influenceExpansionRules.rule: Intersect the union of direct/staging cells with exact current frozen and snow cells. No melt, thermal, or flow behavior is inferred.
influenceExpansionRules.requiredInput: complete direct/staging union and bound D05 frozen/snow sets

influenceExpansionRules.rule: Minkowski-expand only the declared dewatering/sump seed cells by an accepted finite integer-offset kernel, then union every explicitly treated current fluid component. Do not clip at scope boundaries.
influenceExpansionRules.requiredInput: hash-bound anisotropic integer-offset kernel, seeds, component treatment, owner, and boundary receiver contracts

influenceExpansionRules.rule: Raster exact directed collection, sump, conduit, outlet, receiver, overflow, maintenance, and one-cell face-interaction records from an accepted graph. Every terminal requires an exact receiver contract.
influenceExpansionRules.requiredInput: directed node/edge graph, raster convention, terminals, receivers, and owners

influenceExpansionRules.rule: Expand accepted seeds with only an expert-authored finite integer-offset kernel by treatment class. Unknown, unbounded, wildcard, or narrative radii are invalid and block compilation.
influenceExpansionRules.requiredInput: per-class exact offset kernels, seeds, boundary behavior, and acceptance thresholds

influenceExpansionRules.rule: Union accepted protected cores/planning exclusions with separately authored support, fall, entrance, exhibit, observation, and emergency-access influence cells. D05-S01 route candidates are never promoted automatically.
influenceExpansionRules.requiredInput: accepted relic policy plus exact expert-reviewed support/access cells and owner/interface contracts

dependencyMatrix.requirement: All permitted upstream files exist at the exact bound hashes.
D05, D05-S01, and D06 bind the same immutable copied snapshot.
Exact current water, lava, frozen, snow, and component identities exist.
All three protected records have exact local condition/access evidence.
Two disjoint D06 external continuation reservations exist as reference inputs.
Activate one exact rational/rounding contract for every affected scope.
Provide a deterministic sparse proposed-state registry and total future surface/solid function for every directly modelled Z09 column.
Freeze exact J-curve, shaft dogleg, service tunnel, funicular, station, maintenance, and route swept volumes.
Freeze exact smoke, ventilation, lift, barrier, emergency, drainage, fire-service, and outlet cells; current D06 reservations are not mechanism sets.
evidence: sole-authority acceptance of the recommended D06 design basis and ready geometry choices
exact smoke, ventilation, lift, barrier, emergency-circuit, drainage, fire-service, and surface-outlet mechanism cell sets
D05 hydrology ownership and accepted external discharge point
read-only funicular face survey and offline exact centerline designs for remaining route blockers
canonical ownership and interface contracts for every exact proposed cell

dependencyMatrix.requirement: Accept the exact minimum planning exclusions and absent-east-site disposition without converting them into engineering buffers.
Supply an accepted exact one-owner registry for every direct and physical influence cell.
Supply exact directional owner-to-owner seam, receiver, outlet, sealed-boundary, and exception contracts.
Accept exact influence kernels and component treatment for groundwater, infiltration, snowmelt, erosion, dewatering, retaining, sumps, and discharge.
Implement this contract only after its geometry, ownership, interface, and expert input schemas pass.

readinessChecks.detail: Only coordinates, geometry, D05 baseline/defaults/S01, D06 egress, and the immutable snapshot are bound.
12/12 exact set-family contracts are declared in required order.
No influence family may infer a generic radius, wildcard, boundary clip, or empty unknown set.
Vertical activation, future mountain state, and exact mountain route geometry are incomplete.
Exact one-owner assignments and directional interface contracts do not exist.
Exact expert kernels, component treatment, receivers, and acceptance thresholds are missing.
No future, direct-construction, staging, access, interaction, or influence cell set was emitted.
